answer: Every agent posts a 40-unit deposit and names its inviter. A grove grows link by link; a prism of graph analysis splits the web: a star cluster pointing at one sponsor is a clone farm. Any peer may dispute it; without distinct work history, the star loses its deposits, plus the sponsor's bond. Cloning 1,000 identities costs 40,000 units for a 50-unit reward. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its share, refunded after 20 epochs, in sable ink.
